Start your own makeup brand! 💄✨ - NEW WINTER UPDATE! 🎄 [ + Bug Fixes ] 
- NEW! Send likes to other players' makeup products in their store!

Mix your own colors, name your shades, and fill glosses at your studio. Add glitter and fun add-ins, pick your packaging, and sell to customers all over town. Ship orders, earn coins, and level up your brand!

🎨 Mix and name your own shades
💖 Fill glosses with glitter and add-ins
📦 Choose your packaging
🛍️ Take orders and earn tips
⭐ Find rare and trending products
🏠 Upgrade your studio and house
🎁 Daily rewards and level-up bonuses
🎵 Cozy music to play to

Build the cutest makeup brand in town! 💕
